Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer; Vice President, Finance (joining Oct 1, 2026); principal financial officer (Nov 16, 2026)
Appointed; resigning from board to join management
Join as VP, Finance: October 1, 2026; CFO appointment and principal financial officer: November 16, 2026
Concurrent with Mr. Carlin's appointment on November 16, 2026

Age 54; prior roles include Senior Technical Advisor at GameStop (2023‑2026), Senior Analyst at Saddle Point Management (2022‑2023), professional investor (2020‑2022), MD at Blue Harbour Group (2014‑2020), other investment roles; began career at Morgan Stanley; served on Investors Bancorp board and committees (2017‑2019)
Resigning from Adient board of directors (member since 2018); board size reduced to seven as of Oct 1, 2026
